headline: 127 times: Sagar-Runi murder case report deferred again
summary: The investigation report for the killing of the journalist couple has not been submitted to the court for the 127th time, with a new date set for July 22.
details: The investigation report for the murder of journalist couple Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi has once again failed to be submitted to the court on Thursday.
Metropolitan Magistrate Ariful Islam has set a new date, July 22, for the submission of the report. This marks the 127th time the submission date has been deferred.
The Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI) failed to submit the report today, according to Sub-Inspector Rafiqul Islam of the DMP Prosecution Department.
Sagar Sarwar, a news editor at Maasranga Television, and Meherun Runi, a senior reporter at ATN Bangla, were killed in their rented house in West Rajabazar, Dhaka, on February 11, 2012.
The case was initially investigated by the local police, then by the DB of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, and later by RAB.
After more than a decade, the investigation was handed over to the PBI last November, who took over the documents from RAB.
caption:
127 times. The investigation report for the murder of journalist couple Sagar and Runi has been deferred again.

The investigation report for the murder of journalist couple Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi has once again failed to be submitted to the court on Thursday.

Metropolitan Magistrate Ariful Islam has set a new date, July 22, for the submission of the report. This marks the 127th time the submission date has been deferred.

The Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI) failed to submit the report today, according to Sub-Inspector Rafiqul Islam of the DMP Prosecution Department.

Sagar Sarwar, a news editor at Maasranga Television, and Meherun Runi, a senior reporter at ATN Bangla, were killed in their rented house in West Rajabazar, Dhaka, on February 11, 2012.

The case was initially investigated by the local police, then by the DB of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, and later by RAB.

After more than a decade, the investigation was handed over to the PBI last November, who took over the documents from RAB.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: 3 youth killed in [[lightning strikes in Netrokona]]
headline: 3 youth killed in lightning strikes in Netrokona
summary: Three young men died after being struck by lightning while fishing in different locations across the district.
details: Three young men were killed in separate lightning strike incidents in Netrokona district on Thursday morning.
In one incident, 24-year-old Rajib Mia, a brick kiln worker, was struck by lightning while fishing in front of his house in Joypasha village of Kaitail Union, Madan.
According to Madan Police Station chief Md Salah Uddin Karim, the strike occurred around 5:45 am during a rainstorm.
Rajib Mia was seriously injured by the strike and died on the spot.
Police are currently taking necessary legal actions regarding the incident.
Other reports indicate that two additional young men were also killed in lightning strikes in other parts of the district.
caption:
Three young men lost their lives in Netrokona after being struck by lightning while fishing.

Three young men were killed in separate lightning strike incidents in Netrokona district on Thursday morning.

In one incident, 24-year-old Rajib Mia, a brick kiln worker, was struck by lightning while fishing in front of his house in Joypasha village of Kaitail Union, Madan.

According to Madan Police Station chief Md Salah Uddin Karim, the strike occurred around 5:45 am during a rainstorm.

Rajib Mia was seriously injured by the strike and died on the spot.

Police are currently taking necessary legal actions regarding the incident.

Other reports indicate that two additional young men were also killed in lightning strikes in other parts of the district.
